Name: AnimCtrlRename
Description: Renames animation controls and all their related nodes (shapes, constraints, offset groups, etc.) based on a search-and-replace list.

attrs.Help_string:
Overview:
  Renames animation controls and all their related nodes (shapes, constraints, offset groups, etc.) based on a search-and-replace list.

How To Use:
  1. Create the block.
  2. Paste a two-column spreadsheet (old_name and new_name) or select controls and click Add Selected.
  3. Double-click any entry in the list to edit it manually if needed.
  4. When you click Build, all controls and their related constraints/shapes will be renamed safely.

Fields:
- RunBeforeBuild: Check True to run renaming before the main build begins.
- RunAfterBuild: Check True to defer execution until after the full build finishes (so shape files and skins are loaded first before renaming).
- Revert: Check True to reverse the renaming direction (e.g. for entry old = new, 'new' will be renamed to 'old').
- RenameList: List of old_name = new_name entries.
